definition: A commitment to keep connectivity through multiple independent network routes, technologies, providers or interconnection points: backup links, alternative transmission paths, route diversity, redundant network architecture. Counts when redundancy is financed, required or built into technical specifications. Does not count: general network expansion or increased coverage.
note: First cut from Dev's measure template, 2026-10-20; patterns anchored to a climate or energy word where the bare word would match thousands of sentences.
